title: Managed Backup: bank return fee
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines bank return fee.

## Tier basis

**Returned payment fee.** Fee per bank-confirmed returned remittance; USD decimal.

| Contract tier | Returned payment fee |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 0 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 0 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 0 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 0 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 0 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 0 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, returned payment fee is 0.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, returned payment fee stays the same.
